metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: HEHTUN crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C240 H295 Dy34 N32 O171 3+,3(C2 H3 O2 1-). From the CIF bond table, Dy1 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy2 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Dy3 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Dy4 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Dy5 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Dy6 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Dy7 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy8 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy9 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy10 (Dy) has 9 O neighbors; Dy11 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy12 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy13 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Dy14 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy15 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Dy16 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy17 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy18 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy19 (Dy) has 6 O neighbors; Dy20 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Dy21 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy22 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Dy23 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Dy24 (Dy) has 9 O neighbors; Dy25 (Dy) has 9 O neighbors; Dy26 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy27 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy28 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy29 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy30 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Dy31 (Dy) has 9 O neighbors; Dy34 (Dy) has 6 O neighbors; Dy32 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Dy33 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Dy3A? (Dy) has 0 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 67 pairs, 4 components; largest component is a network with cycles with approximately planar metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.616-4.750 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 91.15-153.24°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Dy34(L1)8(μ2-OH)(μ3-OH)21(μ3-O)14(OAc)31(OCH3)2(H2O)15](OAc)3; SI empirical formula: C323H452Dy34N57O222. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 1 μ2-OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 21 μ3-OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 14 μ3-O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 31 OAc (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 15 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 3 OAc (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
